735180101.text: Sure enough, the charging unit is running more smoothly... As you said, the elemental environment in this area is returning to normal.

735180102.text: ...The activity of affected Wenut will calm down after some time, too.

735180103.text: Yeah, yeah... Thanks to your precious Wenutslayer Cannon, we can report back our success and go home.

735180104.text: It's OUR precious Wenutslayer Cannon, Shriya. I never forgot that this assignment was a joint effort.

735180105.text: ...We definitely had our share of disagreements, but without you, the cannon wouldn't have been a success.

735180106.text: What's... gotten into you? Is this about wanting me to put in a good word for you in my report?

735180107.text: Well, I just suddenly feel that what we went through just now is quite similar to our experience from that other year: it wasn't always smooth sailing, but we still made it in the end.

735180108.text: And let's face it. In the end, your solution proved more efficient.

735180109.text: I... uh... I can't take all the credit...

735180110.text: ...Because you were onto something, too. If you hadn't tested the Wenutslayer Cannon, I wouldn't have obtained the necessary data...

735180111.text: "To fix a machine you may only need to replace one gear, but the true challenge is finding that gear..." These words from my mentor are beginning to make sense to me.

735180112.text: I'm so glad you're here, Shriya.

735180113.text: Uh... I'm glad you're here, too...

735180114.text: Huh? The atmosphere between these two became so different all of a sudden...

735180117.text: Ahem! When we were cooperating on our graduation project, our relationship was rather rocky because we weren't very mature.

735180118.text: Yeah. Looking back on it, it wasn't anything too serious...

735180119.text: Well... How about meeting at the café for a drink next time? We could discuss how to write the report.
